title.narrative: Improving the Quality and Attractiveness of Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET) in Lebanon for poor and vulnerable social groups

description.narrative: Contract related to: Improving the Quality and Attractiveness of Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET) in Lebanon for poor and vulnerable social groups - The action aims to improve the living conditions and the resilience of the most vulnerable hosting communities in Lebanon through two specific outcomes (1) Reduce socio-economic insecurity of host communities and refugees; (2) increase the local sustainable production of key crops contributing to food security and import substitution; (3) increase the access, with a local and gender sensitive focus, to decent economic opportunities and livelihoods capacities of poor and vulnerable social groups
